description: Header file defining the HttpBasicStream class, a simple implementation of HttpStream for handling HTTP connections directly over a socket, including method declarations and class structure.

classes.name: HttpBasicStream
classes.description: A class implementing a basic HTTP stream over a socket, handling request registration, initialization, sending, reading responses, and connection management.

methods.name: HttpBasicStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HttpBasicStream with a socket handle and proxy usage flag.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream, preparing it for sending requests.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with specified headers and receives response info.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads the response headers from the server.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Reads the response body into a buffer.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream, optionally marking it as not reusable.

methods.name: RenewStreamForAuth
methods.description: Creates a new stream for authentication purposes.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Checks if the response body has been fully read.

methods.name: IsConnectionReused
methods.description: Indicates if the connection has been reused.

methods.name: CanReuseConnection
methods.description: Determines if the connection can be reused.

methods.name: SetRequestHeadersCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for request headers.
